evals.name: Circular Dependency & Module Decoupling Audit
evals.prompt: Audit a legacy NestJS codebase with circular dependencies between UserModule and AuthModule using forwardRef().
evals.expected_output: Identifies circular module coupling, recommends extracting a shared submodule or domain event emitter, and removes forwardRef().
assertions: Recommends domain event decoupling or shared submodule extraction
Validates module compilation using pnpm build

evals.name: Request Validation & Error Handling Hardening
evals.prompt: Audit controller and bootstrap files for missing global ValidationPipe, unvalidated any payloads, and missing exception filters.
evals.expected_output: Flags untyped @Body() payloads, configures global ValidationPipe with whitelist: true, and registers a global HttpExceptionFilter.
assertions: Enforces global ValidationPipe with whitelist and forbidNonWhitelisted in main.ts
Replaces unvalidated any body payloads with class-validator DTOs
Standardizes error envelopes via global HttpExceptionFilter
Enforces zero explicit any types across audited files

evals.name: Resource Lifecycle & Graceful Shutdown Audit
evals.prompt: Audit a NestJS service interacting with Prisma and Redis for memory leaks and missing graceful shutdown hooks.
evals.expected_output: Ensures app.enableShutdownHooks() is registered in main.ts and verifies OnModuleDestroy disconnects Prisma and Redis clients.
assertions: Verifies presence of app.enableShutdownHooks() in main.ts
Implements OnModuleDestroy lifecycle hook for Prisma connection pool cleanup
Closes Redis and background worker queues on application shutdown
Prevents dangling interval timers and unsubscribed Observables
